_comment: MergeToMaster critic labelled cases. Channel-level, shared across videos; one JSON object per line, appended at G7 (Joel's review) by the mergetomaster-studio skill. Readers skip any line with a _comment key. Never edit or delete a past case; add a correcting case instead. Under rule M-19 the critic advises and does not gate until about 30 labelled cases agree with it. Case status: 'labelled' (Joel's explicit ruling and exact words recorded) or 'development case' (incomplete; not counted toward the 30).

fields.word_ids: word IDs from data/words.json the shot is placed on
fields.render_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact render Joel reviewed
fields.frames_or_crops: paths, relative to the Joel Belton - MergeToMaster folder, of frames or crops showing the issue
fields.joel_words: Joel's exact words, verbatim; never paraphrased
fields.source: where his words came from (Frame.io CSV row, message)
fields.critic_verdict_g5: the critic's G5 verdict on this shot, or null if the critic did not run
